summary: The operative verdict is the breaker's finite cheat against the explicit affine realization of the cross-review-surviving adverse-transducer proposal. The natural determinant-one NAND defect map already has exact grade-zero false fibers 010, 100, and 111 at squared energies 64, 56, and 56. In addition, every one of the 378 saturated binary-signature COPY multisets of ranks 2 through 8 admits the zero-residual false111-COPY11-false111 splice in both orientations, at total squared energy 114 through 120. This kills only the frozen affine defect/glue, not an augmented quaternionic coupling. Separately, a compiled Lean file proves the universal conditional potential-telescoping lemma, its bounded-potential corollary, and the exact 17-versus-four-binary-level threshold; no current tile instantiates that certificate. Q2 and the COPY part of Q1 remain open, and no hardness or dimension-gap claim follows.
hypothesis: Selected mutated Pro Proposal 2 / Fable Proposal 1, the only route surviving opponent review after mutation. Causal mechanism: every adverse seam first has a nonzero leading P-class; a complete lift-independent finite transition relation then admits an integer potential whose local inequalities telescope to sufficient average valuation gain. Expected frontier move: reduce Q2 to finite P^2/P^3 transition data plus the formal potential theorem. Falsification condition: any grade-zero adverse seed, carry-dependent successor, omitted DROP/internal-kernel state, or reachable zero-gain signed splice. The explicit affine realization meets the first and splice falsification conditions.
